usage: project_config.py [-h] [--dir DIR] [--json] [--validate] [--migrate]
                         [--write]

Show, validate or migrate the project's .dev-cycle.json

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --dir DIR   Project directory (default: current directory)
  --json      Print the effective configuration as JSON
  --validate  Exit with code 1 when the configuration has problems
  --migrate   Print the file with legacy flat keys moved into sections
  --write     With --migrate: write the migrated file in place
